**Repeats inside 5 minutes now drop.**

`node simulate.js` is clean. 99 dropped, 0 errors. That is the flap traffic `events.js` plants every ninth event, plus keys that collide within the window.

`[src/router.js:46](src/router.js:46)` holds it. `createState()` returns `{ sentAt: new Map() }`. Only a real send starts the window. A dropped repeat does not extend it. I read 5 minutes as strict, so an event exactly 5 minutes later sends.

Next: nothing.
